feed.rejection_location: Table 3, 0.2 micrometre membrane, transient below Jcrit, 1.6 m/s, pH 7.5, 0.1 bar
feed.critical_flux_conditions: Effluent of synthetic activated sludge production; 0.2 micrometre membrane, pH 7.5, 20-25 degC; reported lowest measured laminar operating point
feed.scope: The source critical-flux point is retained as context and is not transferred to the new geometry and low Reynolds number. Retention measured at 1.6 m/s is transferred as an illustrative constant with 0.5-0.8 sensitivity; not validated at our speed. COD is an external lumped tracer, not a chemical species or a DWSIM property model.

protocol.scope: Verified low-Re fully developed, nonpermeating, straight star-channel hydraulics; axial periodicity represents a developed segment, not entrance losses. Julia supplies a slowly varying distributed permeating-channel model and conservative external COD retention. DWSIM is a water-carrier hydraulic port representation. Reported COD rejection is a transferred sensitivity, not validated at the new speed. Critical flux and sustainable operating time are unavailable at the new geometry/Re; no critical-flux admissibility is claimed. No fitted fouling time, turbulence, osmotic or reactive model.

recycle.tear_location: temperature-controlled module inlet after the cooler

protocol.status: TRT revision; retain all original grid/conservation/pressure/domain/tau acceptance screens.

geometry.scope: Synthetic axisymmetric connected pore, same necks/interface region, body thickness and representative area; only interior radius changes. Both leads are numerical development sections and excluded from inferred body resistance. No reconstructed experimental specimen.

process.translation: Apply each measured body resistance / measured baseline body resistance to the published 3.12 m/h support impedance. One common baseline calibration; no design-specific fit. Use Zhu PDF-v2 effective non-support impedance and its reading range unchanged across designs. This is a literature-anchored scenario, not an absolute pore reconstruction or a viscosity-corrected experimental prediction.
process.scope: Transmembrane hydraulic-load shaft energy only. Constant inlet properties, linear flow, unchanged effective non-support impedance. Excludes circulation, fouling, osmotic pressure, backwash, motor losses, selectivity and strength certification. Actual DWSIM pump flowsheets; no native membrane separation unit.

inputs.Scope: Distributed low-Re synthetic star hydraulic ports from OpenLB/Julia; actual DWSIM water-carrier recycle. Julia external illustrative COD retention; sustainable flux unavailable. Stock lumped channel/membrane allocation preserves port flows, pressure and total hydraulic work; internal distributed losses are reported separately.

dwsim.contract: Suffixes are SI. DWSIM kW/kJ per kg are converted once to W/J per kg. Recovery is mass based; actual volumes differ from fresh-density reference volumes. Cooling duty is heat removed, not electricity.

scope: Compact actual numerical reference; full native fields and saved DWSIM cases stay in the uniquely named generated run.
